prowler.azure.aisearch_service_not_publi.title: AI Search service has public network access disabled

prior_disposition.reason: Identical predicate: search service publicNetworkAccess disabled.

definition.CheckTitle: AI Search service has public network access disabled
definition.Description: **Azure AI Search service** limits its data-plane endpoint by disabling **public network access**. This evaluation checks whether the service only permits connections via **private endpoints** or narrowly scoped, explicitly allowed sources.
definition.Risk:
Internet-reachable search endpoints impact CIA:
- Confidentiality: unauthorized queries reveal indexed data/metadata
- Integrity: stolen admin/query keys allow index changes or deletions
- Availability: abuse and scanning drive throttling and outages

Code.Other:
1. In the Azure portal, open your AI Search service
2. Go to Settings > Networking
3. Under Public network access, select Disabled
4. Click Save
5. Wait a few minutes and re-run the check
Code.Terraform:
```hcl
# Disable public network access for Azure AI Search
resource "azurerm_search_service" "<example_resource_name>" {
  name                = "<example_resource_name>"
  resource_group_name = "<example_resource_name>"
  location            = "<location>"
  sku                 = "basic"

  public_network_access_enabled = false  # CRITICAL: Disables public access to pass the check
}
```

Recommendation.Text: Set `Public network access: Disabled`. Prefer **Private Link** and restrict any residual exposure to specific sources only. Use **least privilege** with Microsoft Entra ID RBAC instead of keys. Apply **defense in depth** with IP rules/trusted services, enable logs, and review access lists regularly.

query "search_service_uses_private_link" {
  sql = <<-EOQ
    with search_service_connection as (
      select
        distinct a.id
      from
        azure_search_service as a,
        jsonb_array_elements(private_endpoint_connections) as connection
      where
        connection -> 'properties' -> 'privateLinkServiceConnectionState' ->> 'status' = 'Approved'
    )
    select
      a.id as resource,
      case
        when c.id is null then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when c.id is null then a.title || ' not uses private link.'
        else a.title || ' uses private link.'
      end as reason
      ${replace(local.tag_dimensions_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "a.")}
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "a.")}
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_qualifier_subscription_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "sub.")}
    from
      azure_search_service as a
      left join search_service_connection as c on c.id = a.id
      left join azure_subscription sub on a.subscription_id = sub.subscription_id;
  EOQ
}

prowler.azure.sqlserver_auditing_enabled.title: SQL Server has an auditing policy configured

prior_disposition.reason: Blob auditing policy state Enabled.

definition.CheckTitle: SQL Server has an auditing policy configured
definition.Description: **Azure SQL Server** auditing is assessed at the server level to confirm audit logging is active. Configurations with any auditing policy state set to `Disabled` indicate auditing is not configured for the server and its databases.
definition.Risk: Without **SQL auditing**, visibility into logins, privilege changes, and query activity is lost. Stealthy data exfiltration and tampering can go undetected, impacting **confidentiality** and **integrity**. Absent audit trails hinder **forensics**, slow incident response, and weaken compliance evidence.

Code.CLI: az sql server audit-policy update --resource-group <RESOURCE_GROUP_NAME> --name <SERVER_NAME> --state Enabled --storage-account <STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME>
Code.Other:
1. In Azure Portal, go to SQL servers and select your server
2. Under Security, click Auditing
3. Set Auditing to On
4. Select Storage as the destination and choose a Storage account
5. Click Save
Code.Terraform:
```hcl
# Enable server-level auditing to Azure Storage
resource "azurerm_mssql_server_extended_auditing_policy" "<example_resource_name>" {
  server_id                  = "<example_resource_id>"
  storage_endpoint           = "https://<STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME>.blob.core.windows.net/" # Critical: audit log destination
  storage_account_access_key = "<STORAGE_ACCOUNT_KEY>"                                  # Critical: allows writing audit logs
}
```

Recommendation.Text: Enable server-level **auditing** and send logs to a centralized, tamper-resistant store with defined retention. Enforce **least privilege** and **separation of duties** for log access, integrate with monitoring for alerts, and periodically validate coverage. Use database-level auditing only for specific exceptions.

prowler.azure.sqlserver_tde_encrypted_wi.title: SQL server uses a customer-managed key for the TDE protector and all databases have TDE enabled

prior_disposition.reason: TDE protector AzureKeyVault and TDE enabled.

definition.CheckTitle: SQL server uses a customer-managed key for the TDE protector and all databases have TDE enabled
definition.Description: **Azure SQL Server** uses **Transparent Data Encryption** with a **customer-managed key** in Azure Key Vault, and each database has TDE `Enabled`
definition.Risk: Without **TDE with CMK**, data at rest may be unencrypted or controlled by service keys, weakening **confidentiality** and **key custody**. Attackers or insiders could read backups, snapshots, or stolen disks, and you cannot enforce **rotation**, **revocation**, or **separation of duties**, raising compliance and incident response risks.

Code.CLI: az rest --method PUT --url "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourceGroups/<RESOURCE_GROUP>/providers/Microsoft.Sql/servers/<SERVER_NAME>/encryptionProtector/current?api-version=2021-11-01" --body '{"properties":{"serverKeyType":"AzureKeyVault","serverKeyName":"<KEY_VAULT_NAME>_<KEY_NAME>_<KEY_VERSION>"}}' && az sql db tde set --resource-group <RESOURCE_GROUP> --server <SERVER_NAME> --database <DATABASE_NAME> --status Enabled
Code.Other:
1. In the Azure portal, go to SQL servers > select <server>
2. Under Security, open Transparent data encryption
3. Select Customer-managed key and choose the key from Azure Key Vault, then Save
4. For each database on this server: go to SQL databases > select <database> > Transparent data encryption
5. Set Status to On and Save

Recommendation.Text:
Use a **customer-managed TDE protector** in Azure Key Vault or Managed HSM and ensure TDE is `Enabled` for every database.
- Apply **least privilege** to key access
- Enable **rotation** and monitor key use
- Protect keys with soft-delete and purge protection
- Enforce via **policy** and maintain key backups for restores

definition.CheckTitle: SQL database has Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled
definition.Description:
**Azure SQL user databases** have **Transparent Data Encryption** (`TDE`) enabled, ensuring encryption of database files, backups, and transaction logs at rest.

*The `master` system database is excluded from evaluation.*
definition.Risk:
Without **TDE**, data at rest remains unencrypted:
- Stolen backups, snapshots, or compromised storage enable offline data disclosure
- Attackers with substrate access can bypass DB auth, harming **confidentiality** and enabling **exfiltration**

Code.CLI: az sql db tde set --resource-group <RESOURCE_GROUP> --server <SERVER_NAME> --database <DATABASE_NAME> --status Enabled
Code.Other:
1. In Azure Portal, go to SQL databases and select the target database (not master)
2. Under Settings, open Transparent data encryption
3. Set Transparent data encryption to On (Enabled) and click Save
Code.Terraform:
```hcl
resource "azurerm_mssql_database" "<example_resource_name>" {
  name      = "<example_resource_name>"
  server_id = "<example_resource_id>"

  transparent_data_encryption_enabled = true # critical: enables TDE
}
```

Recommendation.Text: Enable **TDE** on all Azure SQL user databases. Prefer **customer-managed keys** in Key Vault or Managed HSM for control, rotation, and revocation. Apply **least privilege** and **separation of duties** to key access, enforce via **policy**, and monitor key/audit logs. *Maintain key backups and lifecycle to prevent availability loss.*

query "sql_server_and_databases_va_enabled" {
  sql = <<-EOQ
    select

      case
        when security -> 'properties' ->> 'state' = 'Disabled' then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when security -> 'properties' ->> 'state' = 'Disabled' then s.name || ' VA setting disabled.'

      end as reason
      ${replace(local.tag_dimensions_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "s.")}

      azure_sql_server s,
      jsonb_array_elements(server_security_alert_policy) security,
      jsonb_array_elements(server_vulnerability_assessment) assessment,
      azure_subscription sub
    where

definition.CheckTitle: SQL Server has Microsoft Defender for SQL enabled
definition.Description: **Azure SQL Server** instances are evaluated for the server-level **security alert policy** of **Microsoft Defender for SQL**, expecting the policy state to be `Enabled`.
definition.Risk: Without **Defender for SQL**, anomalous logins, SQL injection patterns, and risky configurations may go undetected, enabling data exfiltration (**confidentiality**), unauthorized changes (**integrity**), and disruptive queries or ransomware (**availability**).

Code.Other:
1. Sign in to the Azure portal > SQL servers > select <SERVER_NAME>
2. Under Security, select Microsoft Defender for SQL (or Microsoft Defender for Cloud)
3. Toggle to On (Enable) and click Save

Recommendation.Text: Enable **Microsoft Defender for SQL** across all servers and managed instances, preferably at subscription scope. Apply **least privilege**, restrict public exposure, and integrate alerts with your SOC. Regularly review **vulnerability assessment** results and harden findings as part of **defense in depth**.

def _remaining_service_parent_identity(item, scope, kind, seen=None):
    """Bind only the three reviewed native service parents and their connections."""
    if kind not in ('app_configuration', 'data_factory', 'search_service'):
        return True
    endpoint = ENDPOINTS[kind][0]
    rid = item.get('id') if isinstance(item, dict) else None
    if (not isinstance(rid, str) or re.fullmatch(re.escape(scope) + r'/resourceGroups/[^/?#%\\\s]+/providers/' + re.escape(endpoint) + r'/[^/?#%\\\s]+', rid, re.I) is None
            or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in rid.split('/'))
            or str(item.get('type', '')).casefold() != endpoint.casefold()
            or not isinstance(item.get('name'), str) or item['name'].casefold() != rid.rsplit('/', 1)[-1].casefold()):
        raise ValueError('native service parent path/type/name differs from selected inventory')
    if seen is not None:
        value = _metadata_only({k: v for k, v in item.items() if k in ('id', 'name', 'type', 'location', 'properties', 'sku', 'identity')})
        for k in ('id', 'name', 'type'):
            value[k] = value[k].casefold()
        if rid.casefold() in seen:
            if seen[rid.casefold()] != value:
                raise ValueError('conflicting native service parent identity')
            return False
        seen[rid.casefold()] = value
    props = item.get('properties')
    if not isinstance(props, dict) or 'privateEndpointConnections' not in props:
        return True
    rows, identities, valid = props['privateEndpointConnections'], {}, isinstance(props['privateEndpointConnections'], list)
    for row in rows if isinstance(rows, list) else []:
        identity = row.get('id') if isinstance(row, dict) else None
        if (not isinstance(identity, str) or re.fullmatch(re.escape(rid + '/privateEndpointConnections/') + r'[^/?#%\\\s]+', identity, re.I) is None
                or identity.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] in ('.', '..')
                or 'type' in row and str(row['type']).casefold() != (endpoint + '/privateEndpointConnections').casefold()
                or 'name' in row and str(row['name']).casefold() != identity.rsplit('/', 1)[-1].casefold()
                or not isinstance(row.get('properties'), dict)
                or identity.casefold() in identities and identities[identity.casefold()] != row):
            valid = False
            break
        identities[identity.casefold()] = row
    if not valid:
        props.setdefault('_coverage', {})['privateEndpointConnections'] = {'status': 'malformed'}
        props.pop('privateEndpointConnections', None)
    else:
        props['privateEndpointConnections'] = list(identities.values())
    return True

def scoped_index(scope):
        if scope not in scoped_indexes:
            import re
            azure_sql_scopes = set()
            azure_storage_scopes = set()
            azure_subnet_scopes = set()
            azure_vault_collection_scopes = set()
            azure_service_diagnostic_scopes = set()
            if provider == 'azure' and scope.lower().startswith('/subscriptions/'):
                from .collectors.azure_sql_inventory import authorized_database_scopes
                azure_sql_scopes = authorized_database_scopes(snapshot, scope)
                from .collectors.azure_swc import authorized_storage_service_scopes
                azure_storage_scopes = authorized_storage_service_scopes(snapshot, scope)
                from .collectors.azure_swc import authorized_subnet_scopes
                azure_subnet_scopes = authorized_subnet_scopes(snapshot, scope)
                from .collectors.azure_swc import authorized_vault_collection_scopes
                azure_vault_collection_scopes = authorized_vault_collection_scopes(snapshot, scope)
                from .collectors.azure_swc import authorized_service_diagnostic_scopes
                azure_service_diagnostic_scopes = authorized_service_diagnostic_scopes(snapshot, scope)
            account = scope.split("/", 1)[0] if provider == "aws" else None
            if not account or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{12}", account):
                account = None
            def relevant(collection):
                # An exact scope cannot authenticate contradictory AWS global
                # provenance. Missing legacy markers remain unknown, not invented.
                if provider == "aws" and account and collection.get("global") is True:
                    if (collection.get("account_id") not in (None, account)
                            or any(item.get("AccountId") not in (None, account)
                                   for item in collection["items"])):
                        return False
                if (provider == 'azure' and collection.get('service') == 'Microsoft.Graph'
                        and scope.lower().startswith('/subscriptions/')):
                    from .checks.facts import azure_directory_join_authorized
                    return azure_directory_join_authorized(scope, snapshot.get('metadata', {}), collection)
                if (provider == "azure" and _azure_tenant_group_collection_authorized(
                        scope, snapshot.get("metadata", {}), collection)):
                    return True
                if collection["scope"] == scope:
                    return True
                if (provider == 'azure' and (collection['type'], collection['scope']) in azure_vault_collection_scopes):
                    return True
                if (provider == 'azure' and (collection['type'], collection['scope']) in azure_service_diagnostic_scopes):
                    return True
                if (provider == 'azure' and collection['type'] == 'sql_database'
                        and collection['scope'] in azure_sql_scopes):
                    return True
                if (provider == 'azure' and collection['type'] == 'storage_service'
                        and collection['scope'] in azure_storage_scopes):
                    return True
                if (provider == 'azure' and collection['type'] == 'subnet'
                        and collection['scope'] in azure_subnet_scopes):
                    return True
                return bool(account and collection.get("global") is True and collection.get("account_id") == account
                    and collection["scope"].split("/", 1)[0] == account
                    and all(item.get("AccountId") == account for item in collection["items"]))
            selected_collections = [c for c in snapshot["collections"] if relevant(c)]
            resource_scopes = {(c["type"], c["scope"]) for c in selected_collections}
            # MemoIndex: joins that checks derive from this read-only index are computed once per scope.
            scoped_indexes[scope] = MemoIndex({kind: [r for r in rows if (r["type"], r["scope"]) in resource_scopes] for kind, rows in index.items() if kind != "collections"})
            scoped_indexes[scope]["collections"] = {kind: [c for c in rows if relevant(c)] for kind, rows in index["collections"].items()}
            context = {"provider": provider, "scope": scope, "_scope": scope, "created_at": snapshot["created_at"],
                "snapshot_id": snapshot["snapshot_id"], "metadata": snapshot.get("metadata", {})}
            if account:
                context["Account"] = account
                if scope == account + "/global":
                    context["evaluation_scope"] = "aws_account"
            # One read-only view per scope, shared by every scoped check (no per-check deep copy).
            context = freeze(context)
            scoped_indexes[scope]["context"] = context
            scoped_indexes[scope]["_snapshot"] = context
        return scoped_indexes[scope]

def _bound_vault_metadata_origin(item, rid):
    """Selected native vault endpoint, never a caller-selected data-plane origin."""
    uri = item.get("properties", {}).get("vaultUri")
    parsed = urlsplit(uri) if isinstance(uri, str) else None
    name = rid.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    if (parsed is None or parsed.scheme != "https" or parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.port
            or parsed.query or parsed.fragment or parsed.path not in ("", "/")
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9-]{3,24}", name)
            or parsed.netloc.casefold() != (name + ".vault.azure.net").casefold()):
        raise ValueError("authoritative vault endpoint differs from selected native vault")
    return "https://" + parsed.netloc

def _sql_projected_child_pages(reader, request, url, parent_id, kind, segment):
    """The four direct SQL projections retain their authoritative child contract."""
    contracts = {'sql_database': ('databases', 'Microsoft.Sql/servers/databases'),
                 'sql_firewall_rule': ('firewallRules', 'Microsoft.Sql/servers/firewallRules'),
                 'sql_audit': ('auditingSettings', 'Microsoft.Sql/servers/auditingSettings'),
                 'sql_security': ('securityAlertPolicies', 'Microsoft.Sql/servers/securityAlertPolicies')}
    expected_segment, native_type = contracts[kind]
    if segment != expected_segment or url != ARM + parent_id + '/' + segment + '?api-version=2023-08-01':
        raise ValueError('SQL projected child request differs from selected native parent')
    seen = {}
    for page in reader.pages(request, url):
        safe = []
        for row in page:
            rid = row.get('id') if isinstance(row, dict) else None
            if (not isinstance(rid, str) or re.fullmatch(re.escape(parent_id + '/' + segment + '/') + r'[^/?#%\\\s]+', rid, re.I) is None
                    or rid.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] in ('.', '..')
                    or 'type' in row and str(row['type']).casefold() != native_type.casefold()
                    or 'name' in row and str(row['name']).casefold() != rid.rsplit('/', 1)[-1].casefold()
                    or not isinstance(row.get('properties'), dict)):
                raise ValueError('foreign or contradictory native SQL projected child')
            projected = _metadata_only({k: v for k, v in row.items() if k in ('id', 'name', 'type', 'location', 'kind', 'sku', 'identity', 'etag', 'properties')})
            if rid.casefold() in seen:
                if seen[rid.casefold()] != projected:
                    raise ValueError('conflicting native SQL projected child identity')
                continue
            seen[rid.casefold()] = projected
            safe.append(projected)
        yield safe

def authorized_service_diagnostic_scopes(snapshot, scope):
    """Join only captured native Application Gateway/Load Balancer diagnostics."""
    from peaso.checks.facts import resolve_embedded_fact, Unavailable
    uuid = r'[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}'
    if re.fullmatch('/subscriptions/' + uuid, scope, re.I) is None:
        return set()
    if scope.casefold() not in {s.casefold() for s in snapshot['scopes']}:
        return set()
    meta = snapshot.get('metadata', {})
    credential, customer = meta.get('credential_context_id'), meta.get('customer_context_id')
    if (not isinstance(credential, str) or re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{32}', credential) is None
            or customer != 'scan-local:' + credential or meta.get('collection') != 'read-only'):
        return set()
    def captured(row):
        p = row.get('_provenance', {})
        return isinstance(p, dict) and p.get('credential_context_id') == credential and p.get('customer_context_id') == customer
    kinds = {'application_gateway': 'Microsoft.Network/applicationGateways',
             'load_balancer': 'Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers'}
    parents = {}
    for kind, native_type in kinds.items():
        envelopes = [c for c in snapshot['collections'] if c['type'] == kind and c['scope'].casefold() == scope.casefold()]
        if len(envelopes) != 1 or not captured(envelopes[0]):
            continue
        rows, seen, valid = envelopes[0]['items'], set(), True
        for row in rows:
            rid = row.get('id')
            if (not isinstance(rid, str)
                    or re.fullmatch(re.escape(scope) + r'/resourceGroups/[^/?#%\\\s]+/providers/' + re.escape(native_type) + r'/[^/?#%\\\s]+', rid, re.I) is None
                    or any(p in ('.', '..') for p in rid.split('/'))
                    or rid.casefold() in seen or not captured(row)
                    or str(row.get('type', '')).casefold() != native_type.casefold()
                    or not isinstance(row.get('properties'), dict)):
                valid = False
                break
            seen.add(rid.casefold())
        if valid:
            parents.update({row['id'].casefold(): (kind, row) for row in rows})
    allowed = set()
    for child in snapshot['collections']:
        parent = parents.get(child['scope'].casefold())
        if child['type'] != 'diagnostic_setting' or parent is None or not captured(child):
            continue
        if sum(c['type'] == child['type'] and c['scope'].casefold() == child['scope'].casefold() for c in snapshot['collections']) != 1:
            continue
        kind, row = parent
        wrappers = [{'native_id': row['id'], 'provider': 'azure', 'type': kind, 'data': row}]
        expected = row['id'] + '/providers/Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings'
        seen, valid = {}, True
        for raw in child['items']:
            try:
                item = resolve_embedded_fact(raw, wrappers, child_status=child['status'])
            except Unavailable:
                valid = False
                break
            rid, proof = item.get('id'), item.get('_provenance', {})
            if (not isinstance(rid, str) or re.fullmatch(re.escape(expected) + r'/[^/?#%\\\s]+', rid, re.I) is None
                    or not captured(item) or not isinstance(item.get('properties'), dict)
                    or str(item.get('type', '')).casefold() != 'microsoft.insights/diagnosticsettings'
                    or str(item.get('parent_id', '')).casefold() != row['id'].casefold()
                    or proof.get('source_operation') != 'DiagnosticSettings_List' or proof.get('read_only') is not True
                    or proof.get('api_version') != '2021-05-01-preview'
                    or str(proof.get('scope', '')).casefold() != row['id'].casefold()
                    or str(proof.get('request_path', '')).casefold() != expected.casefold()
                    or rid.casefold() in seen and seen[rid.casefold()] != item):
                valid = False
                break
            seen[rid.casefold()] = item
        # Retain denied and partial envelopes: consumers require their real
        # status before absence/cardinality, never a fabricated empty inventory.
        if valid:
            allowed.add(('diagnostic_setting', child['scope']))
    return allowed

def _assessment_arm_identity(rid, scope):
    """Assessment extensions can target a subscription, RG or nested ARM resource."""
    if not rid.startswith('/') or any(c.isspace() or ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 or c in '\\?#%' for c in rid):
        return False
    parts = rid[1:].split('/')
    if any(not p or p in ('.', '..') for p in parts):
        return False
    if len(parts) < 6 or parts[0].casefold() != 'subscriptions' or ('/subscriptions/' + parts[1]).casefold() != scope.casefold():
        return False
    tail = parts[2:]
    if tail[0].casefold() == 'resourcegroups':
        if len(tail) < 6:
            return False
        tail = tail[2:]
    providers = []
    while tail:
        if tail[0].casefold() != 'providers':
            return False
        boundary = next((i for i, value in enumerate(tail[1:], 1) if value.casefold() == 'providers'), len(tail))
        segment = tail[1:boundary]
        if (len(segment) < 3 or len(segment) % 2 != 1 or
                not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+', segment[0])):
            return False
        providers.append(segment)
        tail = tail[boundary:]
    # Exact final extension, not a matching ancestor or subassessment child.
    final = providers[-1]
    return (len(final) == 3 and '/'.join(final[:2]).casefold() == 'microsoft.security/assessments'
            and not any('/'.join(p[:2]).casefold() == 'microsoft.security/assessments' for p in providers[:-1]))

def _inventory(index, kind, resource_type=None, *, subscription_child=False):
    _, scope = _context(index)
    envelopes = get(index, "collections", dict).get(kind)
    if not isinstance(envelopes, list) or len(envelopes) != 1:
        raise Unavailable("collection scope or pagination authority unavailable: " + kind)
    env = envelopes[0]
    if (not isinstance(env, dict) or env.get("type") != kind or
            str(env.get("scope", "")).casefold() != scope.casefold()):
        raise Unavailable("foreign collection: " + kind)
    rows = complete_items(index, kind)
    native = get(env, "items", list)
    wrapped = get(index, kind, list)
    if (len(rows) != len(native) or len(rows) != len(wrapped) or
            (env.get("status") == "empty") != (len(rows) == 0)):
        raise Unavailable("collection and index disagree: " + kind)
    seen = set()
    for row, original, wrapper in zip(rows, native, wrapped):
        if (row != original or not isinstance(wrapper, dict) or wrapper.get("type") != kind or
                str(wrapper.get("scope", "")).casefold() != scope.casefold() or
                wrapper.get("data") != row):
            raise Unavailable("collection wrapper mismatch: " + kind)
        rid = get(row, "id", str)
        if subscription_child:
            if not rid.casefold().startswith(scope.casefold() + "/"):
                raise Unavailable("foreign subscription child")
            if resource_type and not re.search(r"/providers/" + re.escape(resource_type) + r"/[^/]+\Z", rid, re.I):
                raise Unavailable("wrong-type subscription child")
            identity = rid.casefold()
        else:
            identity = _id(rid, scope, resource_type)
        if identity in seen:
            raise Unavailable("duplicate resource identity: " + kind)
        seen.add(identity)
    return rows

def _rows(index, kind, scope=None):
    scope = _scope(index) if scope is None else scope
    envelopes = get(index, "collections", dict).get(kind)
    if not isinstance(envelopes, list) or not envelopes:
        raise Unavailable("inventory unavailable: " + kind)
    native, envelope_scopes = [], set()
    for envelope in envelopes:
        actual = get(envelope, "scope", str)
        if actual.casefold() != scope.casefold() or get(envelope, "type", str) != kind:
            raise Unavailable("foreign collection: " + kind)
        if actual.casefold() in envelope_scopes:
            raise Unavailable("duplicate collection scope: " + kind)
        envelope_scopes.add(actual.casefold())
        values = list_of_objects(get(envelope, "items", list))
        status = get(envelope, "status", str)
        if status not in ("collected", "empty") or (status == "empty") != (not values):
            raise Unavailable("incomplete or contradictory inventory: " + kind)
        native.extend(values)
    rows = complete_items(index, kind)
    wrappers = get(index, kind, list)
    if len(rows) != len(native) or len(wrappers) != len(native):
        raise Unavailable("inventory projection differs: " + kind)
    seen = set()
    for wrapper, row, original in zip(wrappers, rows, native):
        if (get(wrapper, "type", str) != kind or get(wrapper, "scope", str).casefold() != scope.casefold()
                or row != original):
            raise Unavailable("foreign or inconsistent resource projection")
        identity = _arm(get(row, "id", str), _scope(index))
        native_types = {
            "web_app": r"/microsoft\.web/sites/[^/]+$",

def _inventory(index, kind, *, directory=False):
    context, scope = _context(index)
    envelopes = get(index, 'collections', dict).get(kind)
    _require(isinstance(envelopes, list) and len(envelopes) == 1, 'missing or ambiguous collection: ' + kind)
    envelope = envelopes[0]
    _require(get(envelope, 'type', str) == kind, 'foreign collection kind')
    actual = get(envelope, 'scope', str)
    if directory:
        metadata = get(context, 'metadata', dict)
        tenant = get(metadata, 'tenant_id', str)
        _require(get(metadata, 'tenant_verified', bool), 'unverified tenant')
        _require(actual.casefold() == ('/tenants/' + tenant).casefold(), 'foreign directory collection')
        if scope.casefold().startswith('/subscriptions/'):
            _require(azure_directory_join_authorized(scope, metadata, envelope), 'unbound directory capture')
        else:
            _require(actual.casefold() == scope.casefold(), 'foreign tenant context')
        proof = get(envelope, '_provenance', dict)
        _require(get(proof, 'tenant_verified', bool) and get(proof, 'tenant_id', str).casefold() == tenant.casefold(), 'foreign tenant proof')
        for key in ('credential_context_id', 'customer_context_id'):
            _require(get(proof, key, str) == get(metadata, key, str) and bool(proof[key]), 'foreign directory capture')
    else:
        _require(actual.casefold() == scope.casefold(), 'foreign ARM collection')
    rows = complete_items(index, kind)
    declared = list_of_objects(get(envelope, 'items', list))
    _require(rows == declared and (get(envelope, 'status', str) == 'empty') == (not rows), 'collection count or body mismatch')
    wrappers = list_of_objects(get(index, kind, list))
    seen = set()
    for wrapper, row in zip(wrappers, rows):
        _require(get(wrapper, 'type', str) == kind and get(wrapper, 'scope', str).casefold() == actual.casefold(), 'foreign resource wrapper')
        rid = get(row, 'id', str)
        _require(rid and rid.casefold() not in seen, 'empty or duplicate resource identity')
        seen.add(rid.casefold())
        if directory:
            _require(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', rid), 'malformed directory identity')
            proof = get(row, '_provenance', dict)
            _require(get(proof, 'tenant_verified', bool) and get(proof, 'tenant_id', str).casefold() == tenant.casefold(), 'foreign directory row')
            _require(get(proof, 'read_only', bool), 'directory source not read-only')
            for key in ('credential_context_id', 'customer_context_id'):
                _require(get(proof, key, str) == metadata[key], 'foreign row capture')
        else:
            _require(_ARM.fullmatch(rid) and rid.casefold().startswith(scope.casefold() + '/'), 'foreign or malformed ARM identity')
            native = get(row, 'type', str)
            expected = _KINDS.get(kind)
            _require(native.casefold() == expected.casefold() if expected else native.casefold() in ('microsoft.network/frontdoors', 'microsoft.cdn/profiles'), 'foreign native type')
            _require('/providers/' + native.casefold() + '/' in rid.casefold(), 'native type and ID mismatch')
    return rows

def _direct(item, index):

    evidence = _evidence(item, 'directAssignments')
    _resolution(evidence, ('users', 'directory', 'pimActive', 'pimEligible', 'rbacHierarchy', 'principalTypes'))

        source = get(row, 'source', str)

        else:
            subscription = re.match(r'(/subscriptions/[^/?#]+)(?:/|$)', scope, re.I)
            if subscription:
                tenants = get(index, 'context.metadata.subscription_tenants', dict)
                matching = [value for name, value in tenants.items() if name.casefold() == subscription.group(1).casefold()]
                _require(len(matching) == 1 and isinstance(matching[0], str) and matching[0].casefold() == tenant.casefold(), 'unbound ARM assignment subscription')

            _require(kind == 'User', 'conflicting user principal type')

def _mfa(item, index, check_id):
    _subject(item, index, 'directory_user', directory=True)
    if not get(item, 'accountEnabled', bool):
        return 'NOT_APPLICABLE', {'reason': 'Disabled user'}
    roles, writer, privileged = ([], False, False)
    if check_id in (CIS_MFA, ADMIN_MFA):
        roles, writer, privileged = _roles(item)
        if check_id == ADMIN_MFA and _GLOBAL_ADMIN not in roles:
            return 'NOT_APPLICABLE', {'reason': 'Not an effective Global Administrator'}
    legacy = None
    if check_id == CIS_MFA and (privileged or writer):
        auth = _evidence(item, 'authenticationRequirements')
        _require(get(auth, 'api_version', str) == 'beta', 'legacy MFA beta evidence missing')
        legacy = get(auth, 'perUserMfaState', str)
        _require(legacy in ('disabled', 'enabled', 'enforced'), 'unrecognized legacy MFA state')
    evidence = _evidence(item, 'mfaContexts')
    _resolution(evidence, _RESOLVED + ('inventory', 'registration', 'contextCoverage'))
    registration = get(evidence, 'registration', dict)
    # Registration is coverage evidence; capability alone never establishes enforcement.
    get(registration, 'isMfaRegistered', bool)
    get(registration, 'isMfaCapable', bool)
    contexts = list_of_objects(get(evidence, 'contexts', list))
    _require(contexts, 'empty policy-required sign-in context set')
    policies = _inventory(index, 'conditional_access_policy', directory=True)
    by_id = {get(policy, 'id', str): policy for policy in policies}
    uncovered, names, blocked = [], set(), []
    for context in contexts:
        name = get(context, 'id', str)
        _require(name and name not in names, 'duplicate sign-in context')
        names.add(name)
        _require(get(context, 'purpose', str) == ('azureConsole' if check_id == ADMIN_MFA else 'requiredSignIn'), 'wrong MFA context scope')
        decisions = list_of_objects(get(context, 'policyDecisions', list))
        _require({get(d, 'policyId', str) for d in decisions} == set(by_id) and len(decisions) == len(by_id), 'incomplete policy decisions')
        covered = False
        for decision in decisions:
            _resolution(decision, _RESOLVED)
            matches = get(decision, 'matches', bool)
            excluded = get(decision, 'excluded', bool)
            policy = by_id[decision['policyId']]
            state = get(policy, 'state', str)
            _require(state in ('enabled', 'disabled', 'enabledForReportingButNotEnforced'), 'unknown CA state')
            if state != 'enabled' or not matches or excluded:
                continue
            grant = get(policy, 'grantControls', dict)
            controls = _strings(get(grant, 'builtInControls', list)) if get(grant, 'builtInControls', list) else []
            _require(set(controls) <= {'mfa', 'block', 'compliantDevice', 'domainJoinedDevice', 'approvedApplication', 'compliantApplication', 'passwordChange'}, 'unknown grant control')
            operator = get(grant, 'operator', str)
            _require(operator in ('AND', 'OR'), 'unknown grant alternatives')
            custom = _strings(get(grant, 'customAuthenticationFactors', list)) if get(grant, 'customAuthenticationFactors', list) else []
            terms = _strings(get(grant, 'termsOfUse', list)) if get(grant, 'termsOfUse', list) else []
            strength = get(decision, 'authenticationStrengthRequiresMfa', bool)
            strength_ref = get(grant, 'authenticationStrength')
            _require(strength_ref is None or isinstance(strength_ref, dict), 'malformed authentication strength reference')
            if strength_ref is None:
                _require(not strength, 'MFA strength proof has no policy strength')
            else:
                _require(get(strength_ref, 'id', str) == get(decision, 'authenticationStrengthId', str), 'foreign authentication strength proof')
            if 'block' in controls:
                blocked.append(name)
            choices = len(controls) + len(custom) + len(terms) + int(strength)
            covered |= ('mfa' in controls or strength) and (operator == 'AND' or choices == 1)
        if check_id == ADMIN_MFA:
            # Only a context-specific resolved security-default requirement counts.
            defaults = get(context, 'securityDefaults', dict)
            _require(get(defaults, 'applicabilityResolved', bool), 'unresolved security defaults applicability')
            defaults_enabled = get(defaults, 'isEnabled', bool)
            defaults_mfa = get(defaults, 'requiresMfa', bool)
            covered |= defaults_enabled and defaults_mfa
        if not covered and name not in blocked:
            uncovered.append(name)
    if blocked and not uncovered and legacy != 'disabled':
        return unknown('Blocked contexts do not establish an MFA requirement', blocked_contexts=blocked)
    return result(bool(uncovered) or legacy == 'disabled', uncovered_contexts=uncovered,
                  legacy_per_user_mfa_state=legacy,
                  broad_mfa_status='FAIL' if uncovered else 'PASS',
                  cis_1_1_2_legacy_status=('FAIL' if legacy == 'disabled' else 'PASS') if legacy is not None else 'NOT_APPLICABLE',
                  semantics='Resolved policy-required contexts; registration alone is not enforcement')

def _expiry(item, index):
    _subject(item, index, 'log_analytics_workspace')
    policy = _policy(item, index, EXPIRY)
    days = get(policy, 'retentionDays', int)
    _require(days > 0, 'invalid retention policy')
    tables = _strings(get(policy, 'tables', list))
    _require(tables and all(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*', table) for table in tables), 'empty or malformed scoped table policy')
    cutoff = _now(index) - timedelta(days=days)
    evidence = _evidence(item, 'expiryQueries')
    queries = list_of_objects(get(evidence, 'queries', list))
    _require(len(queries) == len(tables) and {get(q, 'table', str) for q in queries} == set(tables), 'incomplete or duplicate policy table measurement')
    expired, uncertain = [], []
    for query in queries:
        _require(get(query, 'workspace_id', str).casefold() == item['id'].casefold(), 'foreign workspace query')
        _require(_instant(get(query, 'cutoff', str)) == cutoff, 'query cutoff differs from organization policy')
        count = get(query, 'expiredEventCount', int)
        _require(count >= 0, 'negative expired count')
        # Returned timestamps are positive evidence even if the zero-count proof is bounded/partial.
        events = get(query, 'expiredEventTimes', list)
        _require(all(_instant(event) < cutoff for event in events) and len(events) <= count, 'query expired-event evidence inconsistent')
        if count > 0:
            _require(events, 'count lacks a verified expired event')
            expired.append(query['table'])
        flags = ('allRetainedTiers', 'entireAccessibleRange', 'queryComplete', 'notTruncated', 'permissionsComplete')
        if not all(get(query, flag, bool) for flag in flags):
            uncertain.append(query['table'])
    if expired:
        return result(True, tables_with_expired_events=expired)
    if uncertain:
        return unknown('Zero counts do not cover every retained tier/time range', incomplete_tables=uncertain)
    return result(False, measured_tables=tables, policy_cutoff=cutoff.isoformat())

def _stale(item, index):
    _subject(item, index, 'directory_user', directory=True)
    if not get(item, 'accountEnabled', bool):
        return 'NOT_APPLICABLE', {'reason': 'Disabled user'}
    policy = _policy(item, index, STALE)
    days = get(policy, 'inactiveDays', int)
    _require(days > 0, 'invalid inactivity threshold')
    now = _now(index)
    last = _instant(get(item, 'signInActivity.lastSuccessfulSignInDateTime', str))
    _require(last <= now, 'successful sign-in occurs after capture')
    evidence = _evidence(item, 'credentialActivity')
    _resolution(evidence, ('credentialInventory', 'successfulUse', 'issuance'))
    credentials = list_of_objects(get(evidence, 'credentials', list))
    stale, seen = [], set()
    for credential in credentials:
        cid = get(credential, 'id', str)
        _require(cid and cid not in seen, 'duplicate credential')
        seen.add(cid)
        _require(get(credential, 'kind', str) in ('password', 'accessCredential'), 'unrecognized credential kind')
        if not get(credential, 'active', bool):
            continue
        issued = _instant(get(credential, 'issuedAt', str))
        used = get(credential, 'lastSuccessfulUse')
        _require(used is not None, 'Never-used credential has no verified successful use')
        used = _instant(used)
        _require(issued <= used <= now, 'credential dates are inconsistent')
        if used < now - timedelta(days=days):
            stale.append(cid)
    active = sum(get(c, 'active', bool) for c in credentials)
    if not active:
        return 'NOT_APPLICABLE', {'reason': 'Complete credential inventory has no applicable active credentials'}
    return result(bool(stale) or last < now - timedelta(days=days), stale_credential_ids=stale,
                  last_successful_sign_in=last.isoformat(), inactive_days=days)

def _get(reader, request, row, parent, pattern, version):
    rid = _identity(row, parent, pattern)
    detail = reader.call(request, ARM + rid + '?api-version=' + version)
    _identity(detail, parent, pattern)
    if detail['id'].casefold() != rid.casefold():
        raise ValueError('native edge GET identity changed')
    # The shared reader also redacts sensitive metadata before storage.
    result = metadata_projection(detail)
    if result['type'].casefold().endswith('/diagnosticsettingscategories'):
        result['properties'].setdefault('categoryGroups', [])
    if result['type'].casefold().endswith('/diagnosticsettings'):
        result['properties'].setdefault('logs', [])
        for field in ('workspaceId', 'storageAccountId'):
            result['properties'].setdefault(field, None)
    result.setdefault('_provenance', {}).update(source_operation='get', read_only=True,
                                              api_version=version, representation='full')
    return result

def _profile(reader, request, parent):
    item = deepcopy(parent)
    sku = item.get('sku', {}).get('name')
    if sku in ('Standard_AzureFrontDoor', 'Premium_AzureFrontDoor'):
        family = 'afd'
        domains = _children(reader, request, item['id'], 'customDomains', CDN_VERSION)
        for domain in domains:
            p = domain['properties']
            # HTTPS is automatic for AFD custom domains, but configuration alone
            # does not prove activation before validation and deployment finish.
            if (p.get('domainValidationState') == 'Approved' and p.get('provisioningState') == 'Succeeded'
                    and p.get('deploymentStatus') == 'Succeeded' and isinstance(p.get('tlsSettings'), dict)):
                domain['httpsState'] = 'Enabled'
        endpoints = _children(reader, request, item['id'], 'afdEndpoints', CDN_VERSION)
        routes = [route for endpoint in endpoints for route in _children(reader, request, endpoint['id'], 'routes', CDN_VERSION)]
        policies = _children(reader, request, item['id'], 'securityPolicies', CDN_VERSION)
        # Older versions omit authentication and tokenDestinationHeader. Their
        # absence cannot establish that authentication is missing or usable.
        groups = _children(reader, request, item['id'], 'originGroups', ORIGIN_GROUP_VERSION)
        for group in groups:
            group['origins'] = _children(reader, request, group['id'], 'origins', CDN_VERSION)
        _covered(item, 'domains', domains);_covered(item, 'customDomains', domains)
        _covered(item, 'routes', routes);_covered(item, 'originGroups', groups)
        try:
            _blob_origins(reader, request, item)
        except Exception:
            # Missing data-plane identity evidence cannot invalidate TLS/log
            # configuration inventories; the Blob evaluator remains UNKNOWN.
            for route in item.get('routes', []):
                route['originAuthenticationPrerequisites'] = {'status': 'not_collected'}
        _routes(item, family, routes)
        return item, {'afd_profile': [deepcopy(parent)], 'afd_domain': domains + endpoints,
                      'afd_route': routes, 'afd_security_policy': policies}
    if sku not in ('Standard_Microsoft', 'Standard_Akamai', 'Standard_Verizon', 'Premium_Verizon', 'Standard_ChinaCdn'):
        raise ValueError('unknown CDN generation')
    endpoints = _children(reader, request, item['id'], 'endpoints', CDN_VERSION)
    domains = [domain for endpoint in endpoints for domain in _children(reader, request, endpoint['id'], 'customDomains', CDN_VERSION)]
    _covered(item, 'domains', domains);_covered(item, 'customDomains', domains)
    # Listener protocol is known independently of the effective origin policy.
    _classic_cdn_routes(item, endpoints)
    return item, {}

def call(self, operation, *args, **kwargs):
        attempt = -1
        while True:
            attempt += 1
            self.check_cancelled()
            with self.lock:
                if self.budget.max_calls is not None and self.budget.calls >= self.budget.max_calls:
                    raise AzureReadError("call_limit")
                self.budget.calls += 1
            try:
                return operation(*args, **kwargs)
            except Exception as exc:
                code = _status_code(exc)
                throttled = code in (429, "429")
                # Throttling gets extra attempts; it is the provider asking us to slow down.
                limit = max(self.retries, 4) if throttled else self.retries
                if code not in (429, 500, 502, 503, 504, "429", "500", "502", "503", "504") or attempt >= limit:
                    raise
                delay = _retry_after(exc) if throttled else min(0.2 * 2**attempt, 2)
                # Honor Retry-After as a lower bound; if it cannot fit the
                # bounded wait or active deadline, keep inventory incomplete.
                if not math.isfinite(delay) or delay > 30:
                    raise AzureReadError("retry_after_exceeds_budget", 408)
                if ((self.deadline is not None and time.monotonic() + delay >= self.deadline) or
                        (self.budget.deadline is not None and time.time() + delay >= self.budget.deadline)):
                    raise AzureReadError("deadline_exceeded", 408)
                time.sleep(delay)

def _hydrate_api(value, api_id, api_by_id, revisions):
    """Accept a current base-ID alias only with independent native bindings."""
    native_id = value.get("id") if isinstance(value, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(native_id, str):
        raise ValueError("malformed APIM API revision GET")
    if native_id.casefold() == api_id.casefold():
        return _api(value, api_id, "Apis_Get")
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(.+);rev=([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)", api_id)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError("unbound APIM current revision alias")
    base, revision = match.groups()
    if _revision_id(api_id, base).casefold() != api_id.casefold() or native_id.casefold() != base.casefold():
        raise ValueError("foreign APIM current revision alias")
    listed = api_by_id.get(base.casefold(), {})
    base_props = listed.get("properties", {})
    props = value.get("properties")
    if (listed.get("_provenance", {}).get("source_operation") != "Apis_ListByService"
            or not isinstance(props, dict)
            or type(props.get("apiRevision")) is not str or props["apiRevision"] != revision
            or props.get("isCurrent") is not True
            or type(base_props.get("apiRevision")) is not str or base_props["apiRevision"] != revision
            or base_props.get("isCurrent") is not True):
        raise ValueError("native APIM current revision binding unavailable")
    inventories = [result for parent, result in revisions if parent.casefold() == base.casefold()]
    if len(inventories) != 1 or inventories[0]["status"] not in ("collected", "empty"):
        raise ValueError("APIM revision alias inventory unavailable")
    current = [row for row in inventories[0]["items"] if row["isCurrent"]]
    if (len(current) != 1 or current[0]["id"].casefold() != api_id.casefold()
            or current[0]["isOnline"] is not True):
        raise ValueError("APIM revision alias is not uniquely current and online")
    hydrated = _api(value, api_id, "Apis_Get")
    hydrated["_provenance"].update(native_response_id=native_id, requested_api_id=api_id,
        identity_binding="current_revision_LIST_and_base_API_LIST")
    return hydrated

def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()

def query_for(scope, service, api, start, end):
    scope, service = scope.casefold(), service.casefold()
    aid = api['id'].rsplit('/', 1)[-1].split(';rev=', 1)[0].casefold()
    revision = api.get('properties', {}).get('apiRevision')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,256}', aid) or not isinstance(revision, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]{0,9}', revision):
        raise ValueError('APIM API or explicit revision unavailable')
    filters = ('_SubscriptionId =~ ' + json.dumps(scope.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]) + ' and _ResourceId =~ ' + json.dumps(service)
               + ' and ApiId =~ ' + json.dumps(aid) + ' and ApiRevision == ' + json.dumps(revision))
    query = ('ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated between (datetime(' + start.isoformat() + ') .. datetime(' + end.isoformat() + '))'
             + ' | where ' + filters + ' | where isnotempty(CorrelationId)'
             + ' | summarize event_count=count(), last_ingested_at=max(ingestion_time()), last_event_at=max(TimeGenerated),'
             + ' receipt_ids=make_set(hash_sha256(tostring(CorrelationId)), 1)')
    return {'query': query, 'timespan': start.isoformat() + '/' + end.isoformat()}

def required_types(selected):
    return {'api_management', SOURCE} if KIND in selected else set()

def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()

def _selected(row, key, expected=None):
    """Read a selected field without reviving retained, unavailable metadata."""
    from ..checks.facts import get
    value = get(row, key, expected)
    coverage = row.get('_coverage', {})
    marker = coverage.get(key)
    if isinstance(marker, dict) and marker.get('status') == 'empty' and value not in (None, '', [], {}):
        raise ValueError('native APIM empty coverage contradicts selected value')
    if 'collection_status' in row or 'collection_status' in coverage:
        status = get(row, 'collection_status', str)
        status_coverage = coverage.get('collection_status')
        if (status not in {'collected', 'empty'}
                or isinstance(status_coverage, dict) and status_coverage.get('status') == 'empty'):
            raise ValueError('native APIM parent status unavailable')
        if status == 'empty' and value not in (None, '', [], {}):
            raise ValueError('native APIM empty parent contradicts selected value')
    return value

def _proof(row, operations):
    proof = _selected(row, '_provenance', dict)
    if (not isinstance(proof, dict) or _selected(proof, 'read_only', bool) is not True
            or _selected(proof, 'api_version', str) != VERSION or _selected(proof, 'source_operation', str) not in operations):
        raise ValueError('native APIM source proof unavailable')

def _counterexamples(fact, parent):
    """Validate every relevant source before using a known configuration absence."""
    if (not isinstance(fact, dict) or _selected(fact, 'id', str).casefold() != parent
            or _selected(fact, 'parent_id', str).casefold() != parent):
        raise ValueError('native APIM parent binding unavailable')
    _proof(fact, {'APIM_native_metadata'})
    # The shared identity join also consumes these inventories and coverage.
    _selected(fact, 'apis', list)
    _selected(fact, 'online_api_ids', list)
    coverage = fact.get('_coverage')
    if not isinstance(coverage, dict):
        raise ValueError('native APIM coverage metadata unavailable')
    for field in ('apis', 'revisions'):
        _selected(coverage.get(field), 'status', str)
    apis = _children(fact)
    for api in apis.values():
        _selected(api, 'id', str)
    loggers = _complete_children(fact, 'loggers')
    for logger in loggers.values():
        _child(logger, fact['id'], 'loggers')
        _proof(logger, {'Logger_ListByService'})
        if _selected(_selected(logger, 'properties', dict), 'loggerType', str) not in {'applicationInsights', 'azureMonitor', 'azureEventHub'}:
            raise ValueError('native APIM logger metadata unresolved')
    def validate_diagnostics(rows, owner):
        for diagnostic in rows.values():
            _child(diagnostic, owner, 'diagnostics')
            _proof(diagnostic, {'Diagnostic_List'})
            properties = _selected(diagnostic, 'properties', dict)
            if not isinstance(properties, dict):
                raise ValueError('native APIM diagnostic metadata unavailable')
            reference = _selected(properties, 'loggerId', str)
            if (not isinstance(reference, str) or re.fullmatch(re.escape(fact['id']) + r'/loggers/[^/?#%\\\s]+', reference, re.I) is None):
                raise ValueError('native diagnostic logger reference foreign')
            sampling = _selected(properties, 'sampling', dict)
            percentage = _selected(sampling, 'percentage')
            if (not isinstance(sampling, dict) or _selected(sampling, 'samplingType', str) != 'fixed'
                    or type(percentage) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(percentage)
                    or not 0 <= percentage <= 100
                    or _selected(properties, 'alwaysLog') not in (None, 'allErrors')):
                raise ValueError('native diagnostic sampling unresolved')

    # All-APIs diagnostics can trace an API even when its own child list is
    # empty. Treat them as possible routes when an API override exists too:
    # optional multiplexing is not measured by this native inventory.
    service_diagnostics = _complete_children(fact, 'diagnostics')
    validate_diagnostics(service_diagnostics, fact['id'])
    bad, rest = [], 0
    for api in apis.values():
        _proof(api, {'Apis_ListByService', 'Apis_Get'})
        kind = _selected(api, 'apiType', str)
        if kind not in TYPES or _selected(_selected(api, '_provenance', dict), 'api_type_source', str) != 'properties.type':
            raise ValueError('native REST API type unavailable')
        diagnostics = _complete_children(api, 'diagnostics')
        validate_diagnostics(diagnostics, api['id'])
        if kind not in {'http', 'odata'}:
            continue
        rest += 1
        if apim_rest_api_has_no_configured_ai_trace(
                list(diagnostics.values()), list(service_diagnostics.values()), loggers):
            bad.append(api['id'])
    return sorted(bad), rest, len(apis)
